show.name: Steven Universe
show.summary: A coming-of-age story from the perspective of Steven, youngest member of a team of magical Guardians of the Universe. From Adventure Time writer-artist Rebecca Sugar.

spinoffs.name: Steven Universe Future
spinoffs.summary: After saving the universe, Steven finally has to face his own problems.

spinoffs.name: Lars of the Stars
spinoffs.summary: Follows Lars Barriga, eternal teenager and space outlaw, smuggling contraband and uncovering secrets of the fallen Gem Empire.

gem_connections: Gems ARE minerals from periodic table. Yellow/Blue/White/Pink Diamonds = color primaries D27. Fusion = Klein surface D03. Steven = half-human half-gem = the membrane between organic and mineral.
